scales.geometry: Gao et al. Figures1 and13, method2 and Eq11. Two cylindrical plugs assembled in series: 29.1 and30.9mm long, 4.99mm diameter. Upstream plug is a diffuser. Differential taps span the entire holder; longitudinal resistance of the diffuser, remainder of downstream core and entrance/exit capillary terms are not measured separately. Near downstream outlet, one imaged cylinder is 4.26mm diameter by4.8mm long, about5.8% of the geometric whole-plug volume.
scales.time: Both stages keep total Q constant. An hour-long integrating scan falls in the steady stage; the transducer summary uses the last two hours of a 10–20h constant-fraction step. These are neither identical acquisition windows nor independent repeated cores.
scales.calibration: Q_low=.02mL/min, Q_high=.5mL/min, mu_w=.822mPa s, mu_o=.838mPa s; mu_ref=arithmetic mean. Whole-cell single-phase K=2.045±.056e-12 m². Ca is computed from the imposed rate and fluid properties, independent of the target differential pressure. No core parameter fitted at high flow.
scales.specimen: One serial assembly, low and high rate runs separated by washing and oven drying. Differential whole-line pressure was corrected for line losses by the authors. Unknown moveable interfaces, wetting films, capillary pressure, unobserved regions and subresolution porosity preclude a whole-cell PDE bound.

sources.paper: 10.1002/2017WR021736, EuropePMC6175102 XML SHAedd1a164af3632201c114d4b5845599ef2783da1d19a4f07223fb6c656e2513f. Qualitative published reports of more intermittency at the high rate were exposed. All seven low-rate Table2 pairs are development; no high-rate permeability or plotted pressure value inspected.
sources.imaging: The British Geological Survey accession118450 and its eight-page author guide list seven FW per rate and 14 TXM names. BGS canonical catalog lists two total19.50 GB ZIPs plus introduction; dry/pre-drainage fully brine references or author label volumes are not separately listed. Both bounded central-directory reads timed out. We did not download whole archives, infer their absence, or replace the fully brine reference with end-imbibition fw=1. This course uses authentic published processed Table1 scalar image inputs. It does not perform voxel or connectivity reconstruction. Table1 already includes actual stable-oil-only and oil+intermittent inlet-to-outlet connectivity summaries, which are used in equal-input controls.

input_contract: Trusted initializer authenticates the complete XML bytes, reads Table1 only for the high-rate predictors and the pre-frozen low-only JSON. Low columns: fw, Sw, connected-oil percentage in Table1; fw, Sw, kro, krw in Table2. High Table1 columns 4–9 report stable oil, intermittent, stable water (fractions of pore volume; the two connectivity columns remain percent of their labeled phase), mean water saturation, connected fraction of oil+intermittent, and connected fraction of stable oil. No high-rate tracer pressure or Table2 coefficient is a predictor. The printed intermittent-fraction greyscale equation is not evaluated; use authors' reported mean saturation. All seven rows in publication order. No external specimen used.
target: High-rate normalized apparent resistance Y=1/[mu_ref*(kro/mu_o+krw/mu_w)] from the two rounded author Table2 columns. Both relative permeabilities share one transducer pressure difference; this is one pressure-derived scalar per f, not independent phase targets. Dimensional reconstructed pressure equals Y*Q*mu_ref*L/(A*K), with SI conversions; original raw time traces are not distributed with the tabular labels. Figure13 is a separate plotted summary, not the source of the primary labels. Report forward rounding brackets by expanding each tabulated k to half its last decimal digit (clip low limit to zero; a phase with zero imposed flux has exact zero relative permeability in Eq11 and remains zero); these are printing intervals only.
mechanism: Conditional low-rate static law Y_lo(S) is linear through seven low-rate knots with constant endpoint tails. Under the additional assumption that a small local image gives the relevant whole-cell saturation support and that instantaneous high-rate resistance follows Y_lo at fixed imposed Q, a scan supplies mean m and interval [a,b]. a=max(0,stablewater−half digit); b=min(1,1−stableoil+half digit). Validate phase-fraction closure and mean-in-range. For any distribution supported on [a,b] with mean m, min/max expected Y_lo equal the extrema of chords through any pair of endpoints/interior knots bracketing m, including the point value at m. Midpoint is minimax for absolute deviation over that numerical interval. This does not bound real whole-cell pressure. Saturation marginals do not fix network topology or contemporaneous intervoxel states.
controls: Same-f low-rate resistance; low curve at high mean; two-state support-endpoint switch at fixed mean; two authentic connectivity-volume controls; cyclic support sham; full-[0,1] support midpoint. For each connectivity control split low conductance by imposed f and 1−f: water scales with high/low Sw, oil with connected-volume ratio. Use high stable-oil fraction times stable connectivity, or high stable-oil+intermittent fraction times union connectivity; low oil volume is (1−Sw)*low oil connectivity. These are parallel mobility proxies, not separate constituent flow reconstructions. Exclude oil term only where imposed oil flow is zero. Structural zero/undefined mixed predictions are explicit refusals. The sham rotates supports across mixed rows 1→2→3→4→5→1, relocating lower/upper distances about the recipient mean; endpoints retain own intervals. Full-support width is the uninformative comparison.
gates: Primary mixed fw=.15,.3,.5,.7,.85; endpoints0,1 are single-phase-injection supplemental (residual other fluid possible). Require five complete mixed predictions for each comparator, strict improvement in mean absolute error and maximum absolute error versus all seven point controls, original conditional interval covering at least4/5 printed point targets, and narrower average interval than the full-support reference. Report round-bracket sensitivity, every same-state loss, all seven raw target rows, and any refusals without exclusions. No population-level interval; one assembly and one run per rate. Freeze code before high image inputs, lock every physical forecast before high Table2 receiving and do not tune after either.

revision.reason: The table header says percentages, yet all seven oil/intermittent/water triples sum to 1.000. The text explicitly calls 0.328 the fraction of pore space and 0.339 the stable oil saturation at fw=.5; 0.339+0.328*0.308 rounds to 0.440. Both sources agree on all 63 Table1 cells. Correct units of these three inputs only. All seven high-rate Table1 rows exposed before v2 freeze. All seven high-rate Table2 results remained sealed; fixed role, gate, phase-fraction rounding, connectivity percentage and no post-score tuning rules unchanged.
